title: Robot Arm in a Laptop Bag, Indictment Says: Huawei Verdict

lines.say: May twenty-ninth, twenty thirteen. According to the indictment, an employee put a robot arm into a laptop bag, and walked it out of a lab.
lines.show: May 29, 2013. According to the indictment, an employee put a robot arm into a laptop bag, and walked it out of a lab.

lines.say: The Justice Department's announcement says backpack. It says the robot was T-Mobile's.

scene.caption: IMAGE RELEASED BY THE JUSTICE DEPARTMENT · T-MOBILE “TAPPY” TEST ROBOT
scene.src: Trial exhibit released by the Justice Department with the verdict

lines.say: Photographs and measurements went to engineers, the indictment says.

scene.src: Superseding Indictment S-4, U.S. v. Huawei (E.D.N.Y. 18-cr-457, Dkt. 689)

lines.say: The indictment says a Huawei Device USA report called it isolated incidents. On November twenty-fourth, a jury convicted Huawei of conspiring to steal trade secrets.
lines.show: The indictment says a Huawei Device USA report called it "isolated incidents." On November 24, a jury convicted Huawei of conspiring to steal trade secrets.
